item.title: Rainbow trout stocking scheduled for Parc Natchitoches on January 22
item.description: The Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries has announced that rainbow trout will be stocked at Parc Natchitoches on Jan. 22 as part of its annual winter trout stocking program. The once-a-year event brings rainbow trout to select public fishing locations across the state, providing a seasonal fishing opportunity for anglers of all ages. Stockings … Continue reading Rainbow trout stocking scheduled for Parc Natchitoches on January 22

item.title: Lady Demons start road swing visiting Houston Christian
item.description: HOUSTON—Playing on the road in Southland Conference games has been a home away from home for the Northwestern State women’s basketball team. Northwestern (8-7 overall, 5-2 in the SLC) has won all three games away from home during league play, including against McNeese and Nicholls, which are a combined 10-3 at home. item.title: Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office warns public of church-related scam
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office High Tech Crime Unit is warning residents about a scam currently targeting church members throughout the area. item.title: Parish-wide fire training focuses on extrication tools
item.description: Natchitoches Parish fire departments participated in a parish-wide training exercise on Jan. 13 with a focus on the proper use and capabilities of extrication tools, according to Natchitoches Parish Fire District #6. The training emphasized understanding the limits and correct application of extrication equipment to improve efficiency during rescue operations. item.title: Natchitoches Parish School Board launches Student Advisory Council
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish School Board held its first-ever Student Advisory Council meeting prior to the board’s regular meeting on Jan. 13, 2026, marking a new step in expanding student engagement across the district. The Student Advisory Council is composed of representatives from schools throughout Natchitoches Parish and will serve during the 2025–2026 school year.
